body.statement: Under the stated four-sample design, \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal F_s}d_{\mathrm{BL}}(\mathcal L_P[\sqrt{n/L_n}(\widehat\tau-\tau(P))],N(0,V(P)))\to0\). Uniform map consistency and ass:lift-regularity imply that the half-open-cell lift branch is selected for both \(\widehat p\) and \(\widehat T\) with probability \(1-o(1)\), uniformly over \(\mathcal F_s\); hence the measurable fallback has probability \(o(1)\) and does not alter the limit. This strictly extends the uniform-to-uniform, fixed-source dimension-two conclusion of Proposition 29 in ManoleBalakrishnanNilesWeedWasserman2023CLT to general variable coefficients and to the four-input nested causal functional.
body.justification: The limit law turns the identified multivariate changes-in-changes map into an inferential object at the two-dimensional critical rate.
body.gap: TorousGunsiliusRigollet2024OTCiC stops at consistency, and ManoleBalakrishnanNilesWeedWasserman2023CLT explicitly leaves general-density dimension two open.
body.consumer: Applied researchers can attach uncertainty to the full-time versus part-time employment displacement vectors in a prespecified smooth Card--Krueger reanalysis.

obligation.what_is_open: Establish the uniform oracle-to-plug-in expansion with remainder \(o_{\mathbb P}(\sqrt{L_n/n})\), including generated-target, coefficient, moving-pole, and selected-lift effects.
obligation.obstruction: The oracle triangular array satisfies Lindeberg and the deterministic bias is negligible, but Frechet differentiability along fixed smooth paths does not control shrinking-bandwidth empirical directions. The required tame nonlinear estimate is an unresolved part of oeq:uniform-critical-control.
obligation.attempted: Completed the oracle envelope, Lindeberg, covariance, cell-ratio, and bias reductions and isolated the exact uniform stochastic expansion still required.
obligation.partial_result:
Let
\[
 S_n=\sum_{g\in\mathcal G}\frac1{n_g}
       \sum_{i=1}^{n_g}\Psi_{g,h_n}(X_{g,i}).
\]
The four cell samples are independent by ass:four-sample-design.  A kernel-smoothed order-minus-one Green response has envelope \(O(h_n^{-1})\).  Since \(n_g\geq n\), every summand of \(\sqrt{n/L_n}S_n\) is bounded in norm by
\[
 \frac{C}{\sqrt{nL_n}\,h_n}=o(1),
\tag{5}
\]
because \(n h_n^2L_n\to\infty\) under ass:polynomial-bandwidth.  Hence the triangular-array Lindeberg sum is eventually zero for every fixed truncation threshold.  Moreover,
\[
 \operatorname{Var}_P\!\left(\sqrt{n/L_n}S_n\right)
 =\frac1{L_n}\sum_{g\in\mathcal G}\frac n{n_g}
   \operatorname{Var}_{P_g}(\Psi_{g,h_n}(X)).
\tag{6}
\]
Thus ass:cell-ratios and the asserted covariance convergence in lem:full-critical-covariance would give convergence of this matrix to \(V(P)\).  The Cram\'er--Wold argument applied to (5) would then yield the Gaussian limit for the oracle linear term.

The deterministic smoothing bias is \(O(h_n^{s-2})\), and lem:bandwidth-feasibility gives
\[
 \sqrt{n/L_n}\,h_n^{s-2}\longrightarrow0.
\]
It remains necessary to establish the uniform stochastic expansion
\[
 \widehat\tau-\tau(P)=S_n+b_n+r_n,
 \qquad
 \sup_{P\in\mathcal F_s}\sqrt{n/L_n}\,\lVert b_n\rVert\to0,
 \qquad
 \sup_{P\in\mathcal F_s}
 \mathbb P_P\!\left(\sqrt{n/L_n}\,\lVert r_n\rVert>\epsilon\right)\to0
\tag{6}
\]
for every \(\epsilon>0\), including the random coefficient, generated-target, moving-pole, and selected-lift effects.  Neither Frechet differentiability at a fixed smooth path nor the bandwidth arithmetic alone proves (6) for shrinking-bandwidth empirical directions.  The unresolved tame estimate in oeq:uniform-critical-control is exactly the missing implication.
